summary: Beyond Meat, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report that it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. The company had received a deficiency letter on March 4, 2026, and was given until August 31, 2026, to cure. On August 28, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed that the closing bid price had been at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from August 14 to August 27, 2026, closing the matter. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance notice, not a special situation. It discloses no deal terms, board actions, or advisors. The only forward-looking concern noted is the possibility of future non-compliance, with no imminent action or catalyst beyond ordinary listing maintenance.
